items.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: Throughout his career John has been active as a sideman and recorded with Miles Davis, Dizzy Gillespie, Buddy Rich and numerous others.

ctx.x: Where a great player, there are only a few players that play that way now, that was one of the reasons when Dave would go on a bat, that they had difficulty getting somebody to take his place. Initially many of the people didn’t care for Dave’s playing because they weren’t used to it you know. But once they got used to it, because everybody contributed to the swinging feel this way, rather than — Buddy Rich was a good example. Buddy always controlled the band, although Buddy could play both ways. Because he…
Did you ever have occasion to play or be associated with Count Basie or Joe Williams?
